name: prism-callee
description: Run the Prism lifecycle as a workflow of specialized Callee subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Prism workflow with specialized Callee subagents.
interface.longDescription: Runs the Prism lifecycle as a workflow composed of specialized, phase-specific Callee subagents, collects approval through a Callee Human agent at the human gate, and stops only when approval is withheld, verification completes, or another blocking condition is hit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use /prism-callee:lifecycle to run a Prism story through specialized prism/* subagents and the explicit Callee Human approval gate.
